records.problem:
Mobile App Developer; Summer Intern (React Native + TypeScript)
Location: Remote
Time Commitment: 10-20 hrs/week
Compensation: Unpaid (with strong potential for future paid role).

About Us:
At Tigerian Corporation, we are creating the future of work-life harmony by addressing the unique pain points of the demographic that embodies the future: students.
By using Destress, a lifestyle app, ambitious but overwhelmed students can have it all; a thriving career and optimal mental wellbeing!

For more info: https://destressapp.com/about

What We’re Looking For:
● Strong experience with React Native and TypeScript
● Bonus: Familiarity with AWS Amplify or similar backend-as-a-service platforms
● Solid work ethic, consistent communication, and self-management
● Curiosity, initiative, and a startup-ready mindset

What You’ll Do:
● Contribute to the development of our mobile app from the ground up
● Collaborate directly with the founders
● Ship high-quality features and troubleshoot bugs
● Participate in regular check-ins and provide progress updates

Why Join Us:
● Real ownership and learning experience in an early-stage startup
● Flexible, remote-friendly environment
● Opportunity to become the first full-time employee based on performance

If you’re excited to build something meaningful and grow with us, we’d love to hear from you.

To Apply:
Send your Resume/CV, a short note about why you’re interested, and/or GitHub/portfolio (if available), to arinze.agu@yale.edu.
